messages.text: Hey %s, welcome to The Catacombs!
messages.zh: 嘿，%s，欢迎来到地牢!
messages.raw: §fHey §7%s§f, welcome to §cThe Catacombs§f!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: We hope you have a long stay!
messages.zh: 希望你能在这里待很久!
messages.raw: §fWe hope you have a long stay!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Preferably, an eternal adventure.
messages.zh: 最好是来一场永恒的冒险。
messages.raw: §fPreferably, an §7§oeternal§f adventure.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Our forces are made of rotting adventurers.
messages.gloss: 同上，紧挨着的两句都用「由……组成」，读起来像说明书。
messages.zh: 我们这支队伍全是些烂掉的冒险者。
messages.raw: §4Our forces§f are made of rotting adventurers.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: A party of 5 players is crucial.
messages.gloss: 「由……组成」是被动式直译，「至关重要」是公文用词。
messages.zh: 凑齐5 个人的队伍很关键。
messages.raw: §fA §9party§f of §e5 players§f is crucial.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Time to make friends.
messages.zh: 该去交朋友了。
messages.raw: §fTime to make friends.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Wanderer!
messages.zh: 流浪者!
messages.raw: §fWanderer!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Save your own skin, seek challenge elsewhere first.
messages.gloss: 「寻求挑战」是简历用语，和前半句的粗口气对不上。
messages.zh: 先保住自己这条小命，想找刺激上别处去。
messages.raw: §fSave your own skin, seek challenge elsewhere first.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: You need Combat Level XV before leading a dungeon.
messages.zh: 你需要达到战斗等级 XV，才能带队进入地牢。
messages.raw: §7§oYou need Combat Level XV before leading a dungeon.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Here, I found this map when I first entered the dungeon.
messages.zh: 拿着，这是我第一次进入地牢时发现的地图。
messages.raw: §fHere, I found this map when I first entered the dungeon.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: You should find it useful if you get lost.
messages.zh: 如果迷路了，这张地图应该能派上用场。
messages.raw: §fYou should find it useful if you get lost.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Good luck.
messages.zh: 祝你好运。
messages.raw: §fGood luck.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.context: 入口至二层且未携带地牢光球
messages.text: Don't forget your Dungeon Orb!
messages.zh: 别忘了带上地牢光球!
messages.raw: Don't forget your §6Dungeon Orb§f!

messages.context: 入口至二层且未携带地牢光球
messages.text: It gives each class 2 unique abilities inside Dungeons!
messages.zh: 它能让每个职业在地牢中拥有 2 个独特技能!
messages.raw: §fIt gives each class 2 unique abilities inside Dungeons!
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.context: 入口至二层且未携带地牢光球
messages.text: Right click the Orb for spells, and Left click (or Drop) to use your Ultimate!

messages.text: Welcome back. Are you here to enter The Catacombs again?

messages.text: WHAT? You want to go in alone? I simply cannot allow that to happen.
messages.gloss: 「允许……发生」把 allow that to happen 整个搬了过来。
messages.zh: 什么? 你想一个人进去? 这可绝对不行。
messages.raw: §f§lWHAT? §fYou want to go in alone? I simply cannot allow that to happen.

segments.zh: 你想一个人进去? 这可绝对不行。

messages.text: Hmm, what's this?

messages.context: 向 Mort 展示推荐信后
messages.text: I see.. you have a recommendation letter from Saul. Well, I guess its OK then, I suppose.

messages.zh: 原来如此……你有 Saul 的推荐信。好吧，那应该可以……大概吧。
messages.raw: §fI see.. you have a §6recommendation letter§f from Saul. Well, I guess its OK then, I suppose.

segments.text: from Saul. Well, I guess its OK then, I suppose.

messages.context: 向 Mort 展示推荐信后
messages.text: I'll allow you to enter The Catacombs alone from now on.
messages.zh: 从现在起，我允许你独自进入地牢

messages.text: However, let me give you an explicit final warning.

messages.context: 向 Mort 展示推荐信后
messages.text: The Dungeon you will enter will be exactly the same difficulty as if you joined with a party.
messages.zh: 你独自进入的地牢，难度和组队进入时完全一样。
messages.raw: §fThe Dungeon you will enter will be §c§nexactly the same difficulty§f as if you joined with a party.

segments.text: The Dungeon you will enter will be
segments.zh: 你独自进入的地牢，难度和组队进入时

segments.text: as if you joined with a party.

messages.context: 向 Mort 展示推荐信后
messages.text: After all, The Catacombs won't go easy on you just because you're on your own.
messages.zh: 毕竟，地牢可不会因为你独自一人就手下留情。
messages.raw: §fAfter all, §cThe Catacombs§f won't go easy on you just because you're on your own.

segments.text: won't go easy on you just because you're on your own.
segments.zh: 可不会因为你独自一人就手下留情。

messages.context: 向 Mort 展示推荐信后
messages.text: You have been warned. I wish you the best of luck.
messages.zh: 我已经警告过你了。祝你好运。
messages.raw: §fYou have been warned. I wish you the best of luck.
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: You do know I am dead, right?
messages.zh: 你知道我已经死了，对吧?
messages.raw: §fYou do know I am dead, right?
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Why do you want me on your Abiphone?

messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 2 September 2026, at 21:15.

messages.text: Anyway, you can have it... for a price.
messages.zh: 总之，你可以得到我的联系方式……但要付出代价。

messages.text: I've accepted that I'm probably going to remain undead for quite a while.

messages.text: So, while I'm here, I might as well try to make some friends.

messages.text: Thought we ourselves are but a blink in th face of eternity, our friendship will be everlasting.

messages.zh: 虽然我们自身在永恒面前不过转瞬即逝，但我们的友谊将长存。
